headline.title: Inside Anduril and Meta’s quest to make smart glasses for warfare
headline.summary: Anduril and Meta are collaborating on an augmented-reality headset designed for military use, which will feature capabilities such as ordering drone strikes through eye-tracking and voice commands. Quay Barnett, a vice president at Anduril, is leading the project, drawing on his experience from the Army's Special Operations Command.

articles.title: Anthropic has acquired the dev tools startup used by OpenAI, Google, and Cloudflare
articles.summary: Anthropic has acquired Stainless, a New York-based startup known for automating the creation and maintenance of software development kits (SDKs) used by companies like OpenAI, Google, and Cloudflare. Founded in 2022, Stainless has gained recognition in the AI industry for its innovative development tools.

articles.title: Fine-Tuning NVIDIA Cosmos Predict 2.5 with LoRA/DoRA for Robot Video Generation
articles.summary: Researchers have successfully fine-tuned NVIDIA's Cosmos Predict 2.5 model using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and Dynamic Low-Rank Adaptation (DoRA) techniques to enhance robot video generation capabilities. This advancement aims to improve the efficiency and quality of video outputs in robotic applications.

articles.title: Musk v. Altman proved that AI is led by the wrong people
articles.summary: In the high-profile trial Musk v. Altman, Elon Musk contested Sam Altman's leadership of OpenAI, arguing that he should not direct the future of AI. The jury reached a verdict after deliberating on the credibility of both parties involved.

articles.title: PaddleOCR 3.5: Running OCR and Document Parsing Tasks with a Transformers Backend
articles.summary: PaddleOCR 3.5 introduces enhanced capabilities for optical character recognition (OCR) and document parsing by integrating a Transformers backend. This update aims to improve accuracy and efficiency in processing various document formats.

articles.title: OpenAI and Dell partner to bring Codex to hybrid and on-premise enterprise environments
articles.summary: OpenAI has partnered with Dell to integrate its Codex AI coding agent into hybrid and on-premise enterprise environments. This collaboration aims to enhance secure deployment of AI coding solutions across various data and workflows for businesses.

articles.title: All of the updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s battle over OpenAI
articles.summary: Sam Altman and Elon Musk are currently involved in a legal battle regarding OpenAI, with Musk accusing the organization of straying from its original mission to prioritize profit over the development of beneficial AI. The trial, which began in 2024, could have significant implications for OpenAI and its flagship product, ChatGPT.

articles.title: Amazon Alexa Plus can now create AI-generated podcasts
articles.summary: Amazon's upgraded AI assistant, Alexa Plus, now has the capability to create AI-generated podcasts on nearly any topic. Users can provide a topic, and Alexa Plus will generate an overview and facilitate the conversation.

articles.title: What to expect from Google this week
articles.summary: Google's annual developer conference, I/O, is set to take place this week, where the company will showcase its advancements in AI amidst increasing competition in the foundation model space. The event will highlight Google's current position and strategies in the rapidly evolving AI landscape.

articles.title: Amazon’s new Alexa+ powered feature can generate podcast episodes
articles.summary: Amazon's Alexa+ has introduced a feature that allows users to generate custom AI-generated podcast episodes on demand. This development marks a significant expansion of Alexa into a personalized AI content platform.

articles.title: Elon Musk loses his case against Sam Altman
articles.summary: A jury has unanimously ruled against Elon Musk in his case against Sam Altman, determining that two claims were barred by the statute of limitations and a third was dismissed. The jury's decision comes after approximately two hours of deliberation in what has been described as a significant tech trial.

articles.title: Elon Musk has lost his lawsuit against Sam Altman and OpenAI
articles.summary: Elon Musk's lawsuit against Sam Altman and OpenAI was dismissed by a California jury, which unanimously ruled that his claims were filed beyond the legal deadline. The verdict concluded that Musk was not mistreated by his co-founders at OpenAI.
